Finding: OWASP LLM10: API Gateway Request Body Size Limits
Finding_Details: OWASP category: LLM10:2025 Unbounded Consumption. Source check FS-68: Found 3 REST API(s) and 0 regional WAF Web ACL(s), but none enforce a maximum request-body size. Oversized prompts can exhaust Bedrock token quotas and inflate costs.
Resolution: Configure API Gateway request validation or an equivalent ingress control so GenAI endpoints reject oversized request bodies before they can drive excessive model consumption.
